context: The speaker is a bandit guard holed up inside an abandoned chapel, caught trying to pick a lock and speaking from behind a locked door. She believes the players have somehow gotten past or slain her companion Andorn and are intruding on her position. Her fellow bandits are outside the chapel (either frightened off or otherwise engaged), so she tries to alert them and immediately goes hostile. She’s not very bright, so her lines are a mix of surprise, bluster, and a quick move to combat.
